description: This Java class 'RetrieveAcl' defines a command for retrieving Access Control Lists (ACLs) associated with a specific Thing in the Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, specifying resource paths, and handling headers. The class is marked as deprecated and supports schema version 1.

classes.name: RetrieveAcl
classes.description: A final class representing a command to retrieve ACLs for a specific Thing, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, resource path specification, and header management. It is deprecated and supports schema version 1.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a RetrieveAcl instance from a ThingId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveAcl command object from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing the Thing ID and headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path '/acl' indicating the resource this command targets.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into a JSON object builder, conditioned on the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns an array indicating that this command supports only JsonSchemaVersion.V_1.
